chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen uses a forbidden technique to sacrifice an Otherworld Ancestral God. An upper ancestral god intervenes, a mass grave absorbs the blood, and the ancestral gods return.

og_description: Xiao Chen completes the living sacrifice of an Ancestral God, triggering cosmic repercussions. The Curse Realm's secrets deepen as the ancestral gods summon him to the Death World.
